data.title: Show 7-Segment (I do love my Casio!)
data.solution:
# Auto-generated code below aims at helping you parse
# the standard input according to the problem statement.

# top segment
def a(int)
    if [0,2,3,5,6,7,8,9].include? int
        return '_'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end

# top right segment
def b(int)
    if [0,1,2,3,4,7,8,9].include? int
        return '|'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end


# bottom right segment
def c(int)
    if [0,1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].include? int
        return '|'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end

# bottom segment
def d(int)
    if [0,2,3,5,6,8,9].include? int
            return '_'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end

# bottom left segment
def e(int)
    if [0,2,6,8].include? int
                return '|'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end


# upper left segment
def f(int)
    if [0,4,5,6,8,9].include? int
                return '|'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end

# middle segment
def g(int)
    if [2,3,4,5,6,8,9].include? int
                return '_'
    else
        return ' '
    end
end

input = gets.chomp

h1 = input[0].to_i
h2 = input[1].to_i

m1 = input[3].to_i
m2 = input[4].to_i

# Write an answer using puts
# To debug: STDERR.puts "Debug messages..."

puts " ###############"
puts "#  #{a(h1)}  #{a(h2)}   #{a(m1)}  #{a(m2)}  #"
puts "# #{f(h1)}#{g(h1)}#{b(h1)}#{f(h2)}#{g(h2)}#{b(h2)}+#{f(m1)}#{g(m1)}#{b(m1)}#{f(m2)}#{g(m2)}#{b(m2)} #"
puts "# #{e(h1)}#{d(h1)}#{c(h1)}#{e(h2)}#{d(h2)}#{c(h2)}+#{e(m1)}#{d(m1)}#{c(m1)}#{e(m2)}#{d(m2)}#{c(m2)} #"
puts "#               #"
puts " ###############"
data.statement:
A 7-segment display shows numbers and letters on an LCD with less fields than a full dot-matrix. 
For example the number 2320451640799518 will show as something like:

` _  _  _  _     _     _     _  _  _  _  _     _ 
 _| _| _|| ||_||_   ||_ |_|| |  ||_||_||_   ||_|
|_  _||_ |_|  | _|  ||_|  ||_|  |  |  | _|  ||_|`

This type of display is still frequently used on digital watches and alarm clocks.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A 7-segment display shows numbers and letters on an LCD with less fields than a full dot-matrix.
For example the number 2320451640799518 will show as something like:

 _  _  _  _     _     _     _  _  _  _  _     _ 
 _| _| _|| ||_||_   ||_ |_|| |  ||_||_||_   ||_|
|_  _||_ |_|  | _|  ||_|  ||_|  |  |  | _|  ||_|


This type of display is still frequently used on digital watches and alarm clocks.
Input
Time in the HH:MM format
Output
The time as an 7-segment display within a border made from hashtags.
Constraints
00 <= HH < 24
00 <= MM < 60
Example
Input
00:00
Output
 ###############
#  _  _   _  _  #
# | || |+| || | #
# |_||_|+|_||_| #
#               #
 ###############
